name: Moral Issues
overview: Scripture teaches that moral conduct is rooted in God's ordained order and love for one another. Believers are called to submit to governing authorities as established by God and to fulfill the law through love, avoiding the works of the flesh such as adultery and fornication. Instruction in righteousness from an early age ensures a lasting commitment to God's ways, while the principle of treating others as we desire to be treated summarizes the ethical demands of the law and the prophets.
